meta.name: pr-lens
meta.description: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, visualise, visualize, pull request

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 画出动画架构图或数据流图,让代码改动和系统结构一眼看懂
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果代码改动总是说不清,评审时想让大家一眼看懂
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change or system into an animated diagram
copy.fit_line_en: For you if reviewers struggle to follow what your code changes do

howto.what: 它读代码改动（或代码本身），写出一份描述泳道、节点、连线与流程的 JSON 图文档，校验后渲染成带动画的 SVG。你可以把图推到画布拿一个免登录链接，或把某张图附进 PR 描述里。
howto.when: 当你要求把某段改动或某个系统画成图、可视化或讲解，或希望 PR 里带上架构图时触发。常见关键词：PR Lens、diagram、data flow。

say.text: 把这次改动画成架构图，给我画布链接
say.note: 读 diff、写文档、校验、渲染并推送到画布

say.text: 给这个 PR 的描述加一张数据流图
say.note: 用 gh 把 SVG 上传并写进 PR 描述

say.text: 把总览图里那个节点改名，再推一次
say.note: 改文档→校验→渲染→推送，链接不变

howto.what_en: It reads the diff or code, writes one JSON document of lanes, nodes, edges and flows, validates it, and renders animated SVGs. Push them to a canvas for a no-login link, or attach a diagram to a pull request.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. Keywords: PR Lens, diagram, architecture.

say_en.text: Draw this change as an architecture diagram and give me the canvas link
say_en.note: Reads the diff, writes, validates, renders, pushes

say_en.text: Add a data-flow diagram to this pull request's description
say_en.note: Uploads the SVG via gh pr edit

say_en.text: Rename that node and push the canvas again
say_en.note: Edit, validate, render, push; the link stays the same
